note: Chapter 20 (Partnership) runs from book p.661 to p.662 (25 questions). 20 were kept and filed into the existing partnership.py topic: new PYQs for the four existing qtypes (q-pt-two, q-pt-late, q-pt-working, q-pt-pasture), plus two new qtypes (q-pt-find-time: the profit ratio is given and an unknown time must be solved for; q-pt-split-rule: part of the profit is removed - as tax, or as an equal share - before the rest is split by ratio). Q5 was dropped (the English and Hindi text of a multi-step capital-change problem disagree and neither reading was confirmed against the options). Q9 and Q14 were dropped as plain 'divide a sum by stated relations' algebra problems with no capital/time context, better suited to a ratio or linear-equations topic than partnership. Q24 was dropped as a near-exact duplicate of Q11 (same ratio, same withdrawal month, same profit ratio, just a reshuffled option list) - Q11 and Q23 already cover that pattern twice with genuinely different numbers. As with Chapters 17-19, no compact printed answer-key table was located for this range, so every answer was verified the primary way only: independently recomputed from the question's own numbers and checked to match exactly one printed option.
